title: Higgs' Ambrosial Aubergine Ravioli
subtitle: with ricotta, sun-dried tomato & sage
description: Sweet sun-dried tomato & aubergine ravioli, rounded off with fresh zesty ricotta and crispy sage – traditional flavours that you just can't beat. The trick of this dish is to cook the aubergine to perfection, the rest just rolls out from there.

instructions.title: AWESOME AUBS
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the aubergine chunks on a roasting tray, coat in oil, season and evenly spread out, skin-side down. Roast in the hot oven for 20-25 minutes, shifting occasionally, until soft.

instructions.title: LEMON-SAGE RICOTTA
instructions.text: Bring a pot (for the ravioli) of salted water to the boil. Roughly slice ½ of the picked sage leaves. Combine the ricotta with lemon zest – to taste, the sliced sage, a drizzle of oil, and season. When the aubergine has 10 minutes to go, toss ½ the lemon-sage ricotta through the aubergine and return to the oven. This will help caramelise the aubergine and give the ricotta a slightly smoky taste.

instructions.title: BOILED & DRESSED
instructions.text: When the water is boiling, cook the ravioli for 2-3 minutes until al dente. Drain on completion. Gently toss through some oil to prevent sticking. Set aside. Place the rinsed green leaves in a bowl and toss with a drizzle of oil and seasoning.

instructions.title: TOASTING
instructions.text: Place a pan (large enough for the ravioli) over a medium heat with the sunflower seeds. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden. Remove from the pan and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: CRISP FINISH
instructions.text: When the ravioli is done, return the pan to a medium-high heat with a knob of butter and a drizzle of oil. When the butter foams, fry the whole sage leaves, some lemon juice (to taste), and the ravioli in a single layer for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden, gently shaking the pan regularly to prevent sticking. Add the roasted ricotta-aubergine, the remaining fresh ricotta and the chopped sun-dried tomatoes. Toss to combine and season to taste.

instructions.title: RAVISHING RAVIOLI
instructions.text: Dish up the ravioli. Top with green leaves. Garnish with the toasted sunflower seeds. Drizzle over some balsamic glaze. There you have it!
